rng.msmarco_algorithm: sorted(rng.sample(range(total), nq)); independent Random(seed) for distractors in build_corpus
rng.trec_sampling_fn: all judged qids when trec_nq=0; distractors via src.core.trec_qrels.collect_collection_subset Vitter reservoir

trec.reason: Ranking collection audited by passage ID. Alignment alone is not an official TREC retrieval run; full-corpus indexing and ranking are still required.
trec.official_reason: Full-corpus TREC DL ranking needs all 8,841,823 passages indexed; in-memory cosine cannot hold that collection.
trec.scope: in-memory cosine over judged gold pids plus 2000 random distractors sampled from 8.8M collection; not official TREC 8.8M nDCG

query_memory.relevance_scope: all positive qrels, including positives absent from the index
query_memory.evaluation_scope: sampled corpus; not official full-collection TREC ranking
